objects.description: [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) has used watering hole attacks, often with zero-day exploits, to gain initial access to victims within a specific IP range.(Citation: AhnLab Andariel Subgroup of Lazarus June 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro New Andariel Tactics July 2018)
objects.description_fa: [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) از حملات حفره آبی، اغلب با سوء استفاده‌های روز صفر، برای دسترسی اولیه به قربانیان در محدوده IP خاص استفاده کرده است.(Citation: AhnLab Andariel Subgroup of Lazarus June 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro New Andariel Tactics July 2018)
